Metformin.name: Metformin
Metformin.description: Metformin hydrochloride is a highly water-soluble anti-diabetic biguanide drug.

Paracetamol.name: Paracetamol
Paracetamol.description: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) is a widely used analgesic and antipyretic drug sparingly soluble in water.

Losartan.name: Losartan
Losartan.description: Losartan potassium is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist used to treat high blood pressure, hydrophobic with moderate MW.

Ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
Ibuprofen.description: Ibuprofen is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) with low water solubility.

PLA.name: PLA
PLA.description: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a biodegradable, hydrophobic thermoplastic aliphatic polyester.

Alginate.name: Alginate
Alginate.description: Alginate is a natural anionic polysaccharide hydrogel widely used for cell encapsulation and drug delivery.

Gelatin.name: Gelatin
Gelatin.description: Gelatin is a swellable protein matrix obtained from collagen hydrolysate, highly temperature sensitive.

Pectin.name: Pectin
Pectin.description: Pectin is a structural heteropolysaccharide polymer, moderately swellable and slightly pH responsive.

Cellulose.name: Cellulose
Cellulose.description: Cellulose is an inert structural polysaccharide, biocompatible with low swelling indexes.

Chitosan.name: Chitosan
Chitosan.description: Chitosan is a cationic biopolymer matrix swellable in acidic pH media.
